english:
Activating <void Devour /> restores 70 HP and grants the buff for 10+5 seconds. Reactivating it restores 70 HP and refreshes 5+3 seconds of its duration.

Kills while <void Devour /> is active restore 70 HP, refresh 5+3 seconds of its duration, and grant Grenade Ability Energy based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Tier 1 Combatants: 7.5%
• Tier 2 Combatants: 11.6%
• Tier 3 Combatants: 13.75%
• Tier 4 Combatants and Guardians: 20%

Restores 70 HP on activation and grants Devour for 10+5 seconds. Reactivating Devour restores 70 HP and refreshes 5+3 seconds.
Scoring a kill while Devour is active restores 70 HP, grants Grenade Ability Energy, and refreshes 5+3 seconds of its duration.

Grenade Ability Energy on Kill:
Tier 1 Combatant = 7.5% | T2 = 11.6% | T3 = 13.75% | T4 = 20% | Guardians = 20%
